Post 1
🟢 ASX 200 edges to 9,250.60 (+0.19%) but the real story is underneath — defence and energy names surging while Life360 collapsed 19.44%. Broad calm, violent rotation. Just 0.50% off the 52-week high. #ASX #ausbiz

Post 2
🔺 Energy +3.91%, Health Care +2.15% led Tuesday. Consumer Staples dragged at -1.46%, IT -0.83%. Oil names caught a bid; defensives sold off. Classic risk-on tilt beneath a flat headline number. #ASX #energy #ausbiz

Post 3
ASB surged 17.45% to AUD 4.51 — Austal's biggest single-session move in months as defence spending tailwinds hit home. Meanwhile Life360 shed 19.44% to AUD 23.75. Two very different earnings realities on the same day. #ASX #ausbiz

Post 4
🪙 Gold at AUD 6,193.23/oz with AUD/USD at 0.7050. Silver AUD 91.97/oz. Metals holding firm — supportive backdrop for local gold miners even as the index moves stay modest. #ASX #gold #ausbiz

Post 5
ASX sits 0.50% from its 52-week high with energy leading the charge. Can crude hold gains overnight to keep that sector bid alive? Watch the oil price — if it fades, so does the index's best excuse to break through. Your call? #ASX #energy #ausbiz
